name: Aika
source:
One of the demons known as the Four Heavenly Kings, her specialty is water magic.
With her long blue hair she gives the impression of a cool beauty, the most calm and collected of the four kings.
She usually acts like that, but when she sees something cute she lets her guard down.
While searching for the next candidate to be the Demon King she is spending time in the human world while acting as a high school student.
